documentation_excerpts.text: AI coding agents spend most of their input tokens on tool output: build logs, test runs, `git status`, the same file read again after every edit. All of it goes into the context window raw, and it is re-sent on every turn after that.

sqz compresses tool output before it enters the context. Per-command formatters keep what an agent acts on (the failing test, the assertion, the `file:line`) and drop what it does not. Anything the model already has in context comes back as a short reference instead of the content. Source code, stack traces and secrets pass through untouched.
```sh cargo install sqz-cli sqz-mcp # or: brew install ojuschugh1/sqz/sqz · npm i -g sqz-cli · pipx install sqz sqz init # hooks + MCP server + agent guidance for every client it finds ```
